xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3260: Markdown file chips should open the internal markdown editor in a tab by default, with internal/external choice on right-click

plan.title: Markdown file chips should open the internal markdown editor in a tab by default, with internal/external choice on right-click
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: Left-clicking a file chip in chat always launches an external editor (shellOpenInEditor), and right-click offers only that one open action. There is no internal markdown editor, and the only file-content RPC (readWorkspaceFile) requires an issueId — so the reported case, the Flywheel brief chip (a repo-root file inside the flywheel-orchestrator conversation with no workspace), cannot be served by any issue-scoped door.
narratives.Proposal: Add an absolute-path markdown file door (pan.readFileAtPath / pan.writeFileAtPath) validated against registered project roots + OVERDECK_HOME; a new Stage paneType 'editor' (EditorPane: textarea Edit tab, ChatMarkdown Preview tab, Save with mtime conflict detection); a StageDeckContext so chips can open/focus panes in their deck; markdown chips default left-click to the internal editor (persisted 'overdeck:markdown-open-target' preference, default 'internal'), and right-click lists the internal editor plus every available external editor, persisting the choice. Non-deck surfaces and non-markdown chips keep today's external behavior unchanged.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No internal editing for non-markdown files; EDITORS in contracts stays external-process-only
- No internal-editor entry in surfaces without a Stage deck (popout conversation windows, ConversationDock, issue-drawer/session transcripts) — they keep the external fallback
- No rich markdown editing (CodeMirror/Monaco/WYSIWYG), no autosave, no multi-file tabs within one pane
- No changes to Quickview, readWorkspaceFile, or the overdeck:last-editor preference semantics
- No file creation or deletion through the file door — existing files only

autoDecisions.summary: New dedicated paneType 'editor' with editorFilePath, not an extension of DocsPane.
autoDecisions.rationale: DocsPane is bound to planning queries (PRD/STATE/INFERENCE); a path-scoped editor is a different concern, and a new pane type is additive with no risk to existing tabs.

autoDecisions.summary: Chips reach the deck via a new StageDeckContext; surfaces without a Stage fall back to the existing external flow.
autoDecisions.rationale: The reported case (flywheel conversation) renders inside the Stage as an agent pane, so context covers it. Prop-threading through the markdown component tree would touch many files; cross-surface navigation machinery for popouts/dock is out of scope and the fallback loses nothing that exists today.

autoDecisions.summary: File door allowlist = registered project roots (listProjectsSync) + OVERDECK_HOME; markdown extensions only; 1 MiB cap that errors instead of truncating.
autoDecisions.rationale: Covers repo-root files, workspaces (under project roots), and state-worktree drafts — the real chip targets — while keeping the write door far narrower than the existing open-any-path shellOpenInEditor precedent. Erroring on oversize prevents ever saving a truncated buffer.

autoDecisions.summary: Optimistic concurrency via expectedMtimeMs with a Reload/Overwrite conflict UI.
autoDecisions.rationale: Agents routinely edit the same markdown files (drafts, briefs); silent last-write-wins would destroy agent work. mtime comparison is the smallest mechanism that prevents it.

autoDecisions.summary: Plain textarea editor with Edit|Preview sub-tabs; no new npm dependency.
autoDecisions.rationale: Markdown needs no syntax-highlighted editing surface to satisfy the issue; Preview reuses ChatMarkdown per the issue's explicit single-renderer requirement. Simplicity-first rule.

autoDecisions.summary: New localStorage key overdeck:markdown-open-target ('internal' | EditorId, default 'internal'), separate from overdeck:last-editor.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue mandates internal-by-default for markdown while non-markdown keeps the external default; separate keys keep the two behaviors independent and the change additive.

autoDecisions.summary: Focus-if-open semantics for the editor pane keyed on editorFilePath.
autoDecisions.rationale: Mirrors existing openIssue/openCommits dedupe patterns; repeated clicks must not stack duplicate tabs.

items.title: Contracts: add readFileAtPath/writeFileAtPath RPC pair

narrative.Action: In packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts add WS_METHODS entries readFileAtPath: "pan.readFileAtPath" and writeFileAtPath: "pan.writeFileAtPath"; define ReadFileAtPathInput {path}, ReadFileAtPathResult {text, lang, mtimeMs, totalLines}, WriteFileAtPathInput {path, content, expectedMtimeMs?}, WriteFileAtPathResult {mtimeMs} as Schema.Structs with exported types; create Rpc.make entries with error: PanRpcError following the ReadWorkspaceFileRpc pattern (rpc.ts:318-338); register both in PanRpcGroup (rpc.ts:627). Rebuild contracts so both dashboard halves compile against them.

items.title: Given the contracts build, WS_METHODS exports readFileAtPath and writeFileAtPath keys and PanRpcGroup registers both Rpcs (typecheck accepts client[WS_METHODS.readFileAtPath] calls)
ReadFileAtPathResult schema requires text, lang, mtimeMs, totalLines and WriteFileAtPathInput accepts an omitted expectedMtimeMs (schema decode accepts both variants)
cd packages/contracts && npm run build exits 0 and npm run typecheck at the workspace root completes without new errors
Server: file-at-path read/write service with allowlist validation, wired into ws-rpc

expected_outputs: file-at-path.test.ts passes with all tests green

narrative.Action: Create src/dashboard/server/services/file-at-path.ts modeled on read-workspace-file.ts (PanRpcError codes, Effect.tryPromise wrappers, realpath+isInsidePath containment per read-workspace-file.ts:48-50,120-133). Shared validation: absolute path ≤4096 chars; extension in {.md,.mdx,.markdown} else UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE; realpath(target) contained in realpath of a registered project path (listProjectsSync() from src/lib/projects.ts:307, each config.path) or realpath(OVERDECK_HOME) (src/lib/paths.ts:6) else PATH_NOT_ALLOWED; regular file else FILE_NOT_FOUND. readFileAtPath: stat.size > 1 MiB → FILE_TOO_LARGE (never truncate); return {text, lang: languageForPath(path), mtimeMs, totalLines}. writeFileAtPath: expectedMtimeMs mismatch → WRITE_CONFLICT with nothing written; else writeFile UTF-8, re-stat, return {mtimeMs}. Use node:fs/promises only — no execSync. Wire both handlers in ws-rpc.ts next to readWorkspaceFile (ws-rpc.ts:1040-1053). Vitest tests with temp dirs covering containment accept/reject, symlink escape rejection, extension gate, too-large, conflict, and read/write round-trip.

items.title: Given a .md file under a registered project root or OVERDECK_HOME, readFileAtPath returns its full text, lang 'markdown', mtimeMs, and totalLines; given /etc/hosts-style outside paths or a symlink resolving outside the roots, it rejects with PATH_NOT_ALLOWED
readFileAtPath rejects a .ts path with UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE and a >1 MiB markdown file with FILE_TOO_LARGE, returning no truncated text in either case

writeFileAtPath with a stale expectedMtimeMs rejects with WRITE_CONFLICT and preserves the on-disk content unchanged; with a matching expectedMtimeMs it persists the new content and returns the new mtimeMs
Both handlers are reachable through PanRpcGroup wiring in ws-rpc.ts and file-at-path.test.ts exits green under npx vitest run
Frontend: 'editor' pane type and EditorPane with edit, preview, and save

expected_outputs: EditorPane.test.tsx passes with all tests green

narrative.Action: Add 'editor' to PaneType and editorFilePath?: string to WorkspacePane in panesStore.ts (:18-27, :29-56); add editor: 'Editor' to PANE_LABELS and an EditorPane case to renderPane in Stage/index.tsx (:75-85, :100-121). CRITICAL: do NOT add 'editor' to the ISSUE_SCOPED self-heal set (Stage/index.tsx:156) — it closes panes lacking issueId and would delete editor tabs on load. Create EditorPane.tsx: on mount and on Reload, request WS_METHODS.readFileAtPath with pane.editorFilePath; hold {text, mtimeMs}; Edit|Preview sub-tabs styled like DocsPane's subTabs (DocsPane.tsx:43-56, stage.module.css); Edit is a monospace textarea; Preview renders <MarkdownTab body={draft}/>; Save button (disabled when clean) plus Ctrl/Cmd+S calls writeFileAtPath with expectedMtimeMs, updates mtimeMs, clears dirty, toasts success; dirty indicator when draft differs from loaded text; WRITE_CONFLICT shows an inline banner with 'Reload from disk' (discard draft, re-read) and 'Overwrite' (re-save without expectedMtimeMs); FILE_TOO_LARGE and other read errors render an error state, too-large additionally offering 'Open externally' via the existing resolvePreferredEditor + shellOpenInEditor flow; a pane missing editorFilePath renders an explicit error state rather than crashing. Tests mock getTransport (pattern MarkdownFileLink.test.tsx:17-19).

items.title: Given a pane with editorFilePath, EditorPane renders the file text in the Edit textarea and the Preview sub-tab renders the draft as markdown through MarkdownTab
Editing then saving sends writeFileAtPath with the draft content and the last-read expectedMtimeMs, and Ctrl/Cmd+S triggers the same save; the dirty indicator clears after a successful save
A WRITE_CONFLICT response renders Reload-from-disk and Overwrite actions; Overwrite re-sends the save without expectedMtimeMs and Reload replaces the draft with freshly read content
A FILE_TOO_LARGE read error renders an error state offering Open externally, and a pane missing editorFilePath renders an error state without throwing
The Stage self-heal effect preserves 'editor' panes on deck load (the ISSUE_SCOPED set does not contain 'editor'), verified by test or by the pane surviving a store rehydrate in EditorPane.test.tsx
Frontend: StageDeckContext so nested chips can open panes in their deck

narrative.Action: Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/Stage/StageDeckContext.tsx exporting a React context with value { deckKey: string; openOrFocusEditorPane: (filePath: string, label: string) => void } | null and a useStageDeck() hook. In Stage (Stage/index.tsx), implement openOrFocusEditorPane mirroring openIssue (:206-214): find a pane with paneType 'editor' and matching editorFilePath → setActivePane, else addPane(deckKey, { paneType: 'editor', label, editorFilePath: filePath }). Wrap everything Stage renders (pane layout plus renderHome/renderIssue output) in the provider so AgentPane → ConversationPanel → ChatMarkdown → MarkdownFileLink can consume it.

items.title: useStageDeck() inside any Stage-rendered pane returns the deck's key and a working openOrFocusEditorPane, and returns null when rendered outside a Stage
openOrFocusEditorPane called twice with the same filePath creates one editor pane and focuses it on the second call (no duplicate tab)
Frontend: markdown chips left-click opens the internal editor by default

expected_outputs: MarkdownFileLink.test.tsx passes with all pre-existing and new tests green

narrative.Action: Extend editorPreferences.ts with MarkdownOpenTarget = 'internal' | EditorId, getMarkdownOpenTarget() (reads localStorage key 'overdeck:markdown-open-target', defaults 'internal'), and setMarkdownOpenTarget(). In MarkdownFileLink.tsx add isMarkdownPath via the existing extensionOfPath (:77-81) for {md,mdx,markdown}. Change the left-click handler (:288-292): markdown chip with target 'internal' and useStageDeck() non-null → deck.openOrFocusEditorPane(targetPath, basename); markdown chip with an external EditorId target → launch that editor via the existing shellOpenInEditor flow; markdown chip with 'internal' but null deck context → existing handleOpen() external fallback; non-markdown chips → handleOpen() unchanged. Extend tests: internal default opens the pane (mocked StageDeckContext provider) and never calls shellOpenInEditor; a named test covers the reported case — a repo-root markdown targetPath with no issueId prop and no /workspaces/feature-*/ segment still opens the pane; a persisted external target launches externally; null context falls back to shellOpenInEditor; all pre-existing tests still pass.

items.title: Given a markdown chip inside a StageDeckContext and no stored preference, left click opens/focuses an editor pane for targetPath and shellOpenInEditor is not called
A named test covering a repo-root markdown chip with no issueId and no workspace path segment (the flywheel-brief case) passes: the editor pane opens with the absolute targetPath

With a persisted external EditorId as the markdown open target, left click launches that external editor and opens no pane; with null deck context and 'internal' target, left click falls back to the existing external flow
Non-markdown chips (e.g. .ts) keep launching the preferred external editor on left click, and every pre-existing MarkdownFileLink test passes
Frontend: markdown chip right-click lists internal plus available external editors and persists the choice

expected_outputs: MarkdownFileLink.test.tsx passes with all tests green

narrative.Action: In MarkdownFileLink.tsx, for markdown chips replace the single 'Open in editor' context-menu item: capture event.clientX/clientY, await a module-level cached pan.getAvailableEditors fetch (pattern: sharedQuickviewHighlighterPromise at :75,121-135; on fetch failure proceed with an empty external list), then showContextMenu with items in order: 'Open in internal editor' (persists setMarkdownOpenTarget('internal') then opens/focuses the pane, or external fallback when deck context is null), one 'Open in <label>' per available editor using EDITORS labels (persists setMarkdownOpenTarget(id) then launches via shellOpenInEditor), then the existing 'Copy relative path' and 'Copy full path' items unchanged. Non-markdown chips keep the current three-item menu verbatim (contextMenuFallback.ts needs no changes). Tests: menu order internal → externals → copy items; choosing an external persists the target so a subsequent left click launches it; choosing internal persists 'internal'; non-markdown menu unchanged.

items.title: Right-clicking a markdown chip renders a menu listing 'Open in internal editor', one entry per available external editor, and both copy actions, in that order

Choosing an external editor from the menu launches it via shellOpenInEditor and persists the choice so a subsequent left click launches the same editor after a simulated reload (fresh localStorage read)
Choosing 'Open in internal editor' opens/focuses the editor pane and persists 'internal' as the markdown open target
Right-clicking a non-markdown chip renders exactly today's three items (Open in editor, Copy relative path, Copy full path)
Docs: document the editor pane, file door, and chip preference model

expected_outputs: docs/MARKDOWN-EDITOR-PANE.md exists and is non-trivial (>40 lines)

narrative.Action: Create docs/MARKDOWN-EDITOR-PANE.md documenting: the 'editor' paneType and its editorFilePath field (and why it is NOT in Stage's ISSUE_SCOPED self-heal set); the pan.readFileAtPath / pan.writeFileAtPath door — allowlist (registered project roots + OVERDECK_HOME), markdown-only extensions, 1 MiB error-not-truncate cap, and the expectedMtimeMs/WRITE_CONFLICT protocol; the StageDeckContext mechanism chips use to open panes; the overdeck:markdown-open-target preference ('internal' | EditorId, default 'internal') and its relationship to overdeck:last-editor; and the fallback matrix (deck surfaces open internally, popout/dock/drawer surfaces keep the external flow, non-markdown chips unchanged).

items.title: docs/MARKDOWN-EDITOR-PANE.md contains the editor pane type, the file door validation rules (allowlist, markdown-only, 1 MiB error cap), and covers the WRITE_CONFLICT mtime protocol with the exact RPC method names

The doc shows the fallback matrix — which surfaces open internally versus externally and that non-markdown chips are unchanged — and contains the overdeck:markdown-open-target localStorage key with its default
